_comment: BASE TEMPLATE — Do not remove or modify framework schema sections. Runtime state (below) resets to defaults on directive completion.

_persistentState.description: PERSISTENT EXECUTION LEDGER — Schema reference for task decomposition. Two-Phase Dispatch (Research -> Implement) handled at Phase level. This template is immutable — it defines the contract, not the work.

structure.phaseId: Descriptive hyphenated ID derived exactly from PLAN.md
structure.planPhaseRef: Exact phase row from the Architect-approved PLAN.md
structure.phaseDescription: The high-level goal, boundaries, and context of this phase as defined by the Architect
structure.state: pending | researching | spec_ready | implementing | completed | blocked | paused

_taskId.id: Descriptive task ID matching phase hierarchy
_taskId.description: Granular action item required to achieve the active phase goal
_taskId.state: pending | researching | spec_ready | implementing | completed | blocked | paused
_taskId.agent: Current or most recent agent type/name/session and dispatch phase

lookaheadPhases.description: Active research/spec state for downstream phases in the Architect-approved PLAN.md, researched ahead while the current phase implements. Each entry mirrors the phase-scoped root shape (phaseId, planPhaseRef, phaseDescription, state, phaseHealth, tasks, phaseSuccessCriteria, progressEntries); the global activeAgents registry remains at the runtime root. Lookahead tasks may be pending/researching/spec_ready/blocked/paused but never implementing until the phase is promoted to root. Entries are active non-completed records, not history.

activeAgents.description: Live registry of currently-open agent handles (agent id/name, served taskId, phase, state, dispatch timestamp, terminal-pending flag). Add on dispatch; remove on retire. Orchestrator source of truth for true concurrency consumption — consult before any new dispatch. Resets to empty on directive completion.

_archive.description: PERSISTENT ARCHIVE — Survives directive completion and runtime reset. Schema-compatible legacy section; runtime completion history is preserved in root log.md, not here.
